newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end below 48-point key support.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end below 48-point key support.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended below a key 48-point support level on Monday mainly caused by recent falls of market barometer Shanghai Lujiazui Finance & Trade Zone Development, brokers said.
The index fell 0.301 points or 0.62 percent to 47.938 points, on volume of 6.2 million shares worth $2.1 million. Of 41 B shares, 37 traded, with 21 down, eight flat and eight up.
Brokers said falls of Shanghai Lujiazui in the past few days had hurt market sentiment and triggered heavy liquidation in other stocks.
Shanghai Lujiazui fell $0.002 or 0.22 percent to $0.894 on volume of 599,900 shares.

"Selling was mainly from overseas and the bullish A stock market also attracted domestic capital from the B share market, which depressed market sentiment further despite some institutional support," one broker said.
"The index will fall further in the coming days if there is no positive news, as it is difficult to change the bearish mood in the short term," he added.
Shanghai Jintai was the biggest loser on its poor results, falling $0.010 or 7.69 percent to $0.120, on volume of 200,000 shares.
Shanghai Automation Instrumentation traded the most on intra-institutional trading, ended unchanged at $0.130 on volume of 1.1 million shares.

Shanghai A shares rose in active trading on bullish sentiment, with speculation dominating the market, brokers said. The index rose 11.078 points or 1.04 percent to 1077.735 points, on volume of 937.1 million shares worth 8.5 billion yuan.
But the SSE 30 blue-chip index fell 4.184 points or 0.16 percent to 2637.117 points.

Shanghai Shenhua Electronics was the star on rumours that an institution would announce that they hold more than five percent of its total shares, fuelling speculation of a possible takeover of the company, brokers said.
It surged 4.29 yuan or 20.71 percent to 25.00 yuan, on volume of 11.5 million shares.
